$schema_comment: SORA baf-standard third-party / high-risk path whitelist. Edit for your project.
description: Paths listed here are treated as third-party/SDK/BSP: high-risk constructs (malloc/goto/recursion) are expected; writes are forbidden unless explicitly authorized.
notes: allowHighRisk=true: code under this path may contain malloc/goto/recursion without per-call HIGH-RISK comments in first-party style.
writePolicy=deny_by_default: Agent/hook must not Edit/Write here unless the user explicitly authorizes a named path and reason.
First-party code outside these globs: high-risk still needs user confirmation + HIGH-RISK comment + review checklist.
Hard enforcement: baf-guard hooks / CI (P2+). Soft guidance: sora-c-code-standards skill.
